LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_QubitDecryption.label: qubit decryption
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_QubitDecryption.descriptio:
A decoding technique that bypasses a stele's own verification layer and reads its data by directly measuring the quantum state held at each lattice site of its holographic storage plates. The stele's encryption rests on the assumption that no one outside the fleets can observe those quantum states without collapsing them; this technique simply chooses to accept the collapse. Every reading permanently destroys the region it reads. What is recovered can be archived for research, and what is lost can never be restored.
The technique was leaked by fleet deviants. Steles are the backup memory of every colonial world, and every stele scanned this way is a record that no one will ever be able to read again.

Approved by ████ and ███, qubit decryption and its related technologies are designated class II sealed technology. Disclosure of such technology is prohibited, and any decoding equipment discovered is to be destroyed on site.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_QubitDecryption.discovered:
Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology. It contains a stele decryption technique leaked by fleet deviants.

The decoder can now be built. Set flush against a stele and supplied with power, it can extract the occultech knowledge stored in the stele.

With this method in hand, the colony can also trace the occultech glyphs scattered across this world. Recovering the glyphs will lead to a stele.

The fleets sealed this file to keep the data in the steles out of anyone else's hands. Every stele read this way is a permanent loss to the fleets.
